profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA. Its AI-facing website presents it as a platform for developers, offering access to its AI models and tools through the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with the OpenAI SDK. The site highlights several products under the Muse family: Muse Spark, described as a coding-optimized model that writes, reviews, and ships code with fewer steps and lower latency; Muse Code, a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; and Muse Glimmer, described as a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site also references multi-agent workflows, computer-use capabilities, and search grounding via a web-access tool.

Meta's tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted, available at llama.com. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, per its most recent 10-K filing, and trades publicly under the ticker META with CIK 0001326801.

Meta is a defendant in three tracked legal cases: Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. and Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc., both in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, and Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas. Several third-party MCP servers built around Meta's advertising infrastructure also appear in the registry, covering campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis for Facebook and Instagram ads.
